section_summary.extract_value: This section describes participant recruitment and procedure for a study of British men recruited via the YMCA and online media, with inclusion criteria of male and 18+; participants completed the study online and provided consent and demographics. A total of 440 men participated (breakdown by sexual orientation provided); the section references Table 1 for additional demographics and notes participants were invited to 6- and 12-month follow-ups as part of a separate longitudinal study to be published separately.
